products.name: Clio Manage
products.pricingModel: per user per month, four tiers (Starter, Core, Signature, Elite)
products.publishedPrice: Starting at US$49 per user per month (Starter); Core, Signature and Elite behind a quote flow (V, clio.com/pricing, retrieved 2026-09-29)
products.sizeFitNote: ASSUMED (vendor Series F release cites mid-sized firms; pricing page has no size statement)
products.integrationsNote: 300 plus integrations stated; App Directory page 1 features InfoTrack, CallRail, Steno, Case Status, Legl, AltFee, OurFamilyWizard, Scorpion (V, https://www.clio.com/app-directory/)

bucketNotes.function-trust-accounting: All four plans list trust account management and trust and operating reconciliation plus a free accountant license; three-way reconciliation not named on the page (V)
bucketNotes.function-document-management: Document storage and management in all plans (V)
bucketNotes.function-calendaring-deadlines: Court calendaring rules: none in Starter, 3 per firm in Core, 10 per firm in Signature and Elite (V)
bucketNotes.function-conflicts: Conflict check in Core and above, not Starter (V)
bucketNotes.function-esignature: E-signature included: Starter 3 signatures, Core 15, Signature and Elite unlimited (V); no ESIGN or UETA statement on the security page (V)

products.name: MyCase
products.pricingModel: per user per month, three tiers, monthly or annual

products.sizeFitNote: ASSUMED (priced on active firm users; no size statement on the page)
products.integrationsNote: 61 integrations listed, including QuickBooks, LawPay, Gmail, Outlook, Google Calendar, Dropbox, NetDocuments, Zapier, Lawmatics, InfoTrack, LawToolBox, Claude via MyCase MCP (V, https://www.mycase.com/integrations/)

bucketNotes.function-trust-accounting: All plans include Trust Ledger and Reconciliation and Trust by Case; three-way reconciliation only through the MyCase Accounting add-on at US$39 per user per month (V)
bucketNotes.function-intake-crm: Basic has no intake; Pro and Advanced include Client Intake Forms and Legal CRM (V)
bucketNotes.function-client-portal: Unlimited client portal users; pricing based on active firm users (V)
bucketNotes.function-calendaring-deadlines: Court-rules calendaring in Advanced only, subscription required (V)
bucketNotes.function-conflicts: Conflict check search across cases, contacts and documents in all plans (V)
